description: Fetches one of your renders by id (GET /mastering/jobs/{id}): status (queued, decoding, analyzing, rendering, done, failed, cancelled, expired), progress, queue position, a copy of the settings used and, once done, the loudness measures before and after (`report`) and the sha256 of the result. With download=true on a finished render, the mastered WAV (GET /mastering/jobs/{id}/result, free to repeat) is downloaded to a local file and its path returned. A render unknown or belonging to another account answers the same 404; results are kept 24 hours (410 afterwards). Costs no quota (read rate limit): poll no faster than every few seconds.

download.description: true: when the render is done, download the WAV and return its local path. Default false: status only.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_master_audio (a UUID).

name: jj_mastering_get_job
title: Get a Mastering render status
